title: Future Subjunctive with quando and se
titlePt: Futuro do subjuntivo com quando e se
summary: Use the future subjunctive for future conditions after quando, se, assim que, and enquanto.

sections.heading: Future, not present
sections.body: After **quando**, **se**, **assim que**, and similar connectors, Portuguese uses the **future subjunctive** when the action is future and uncertain. English often uses the present tense in the same place.

examples.en: When you arrive, let me know.

examples.pt: Se chover, vamos ficar em casa.
examples.en: If it rains, we will stay home.

examples.pt: Assim que eu terminar, te ligo.
examples.en: As soon as I finish, I'll call you.

sections.heading: Regular future subjunctive tables
sections.body:
For regular verbs, the future subjunctive often looks like the infinitive for eu and você/ele/ela, then adds **-mos** and **-em** for plural subjects.

| Subject | falar | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| quando/se eu | **falar** | **comer** | **abrir** |
| quando/se você/ele/ela | **falar** | **comer** | **abrir** |
| quando/se nós | **falarmos** | **comermos** | **abrirmos** |
| quando/se vocês/eles/elas | **falarem** | **comerem** | **abrirem** |

examples.pt: Quando nós falarmos com ela, vamos explicar.
examples.en: When we talk to her, we will explain.

examples.pt: Se eles comerem antes, tudo bem.
examples.en: If they eat beforehand, that's fine.

examples.pt: Quando a loja abrir, eu entro.
examples.en: When the store opens, I'll go in.

sections.heading: Common irregular future subjunctive forms
sections.body:
Many irregular future subjunctives come from the preterite stem.

| Subject | ser/ir | ter | fazer | poder | querer | vir | dizer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| se eu | **for** | **tiver** | **fizer** | **puder** | **quiser** | **vier** | **disser** |
| se você/ele/ela | **for** | **tiver** | **fizer** | **puder** | **quiser** | **vier** | **disser** |
| se nós | **formos** | **tivermos** | **fizermos** | **pudermos** | **quisermos** | **viermos** | **dissermos** |
| se vocês/eles/elas | **forem** | **tiverem** | **fizerem** | **puderem** | **quiserem** | **vierem** | **disserem** |

examples.pt: Se eu tiver tempo, passo aí.
examples.en: If I have time, I will stop by.

examples.pt: Quando nós formos ao mercado, compraremos leite.
examples.en: When we go to the market, we will buy milk.

examples.pt: Se eles disserem a verdade, tudo muda.
examples.en: If they tell the truth, everything changes.

keyPoints: Use future subjunctive after se/quando for future conditions.
English often uses present where Portuguese uses future subjunctive.
Regular forms resemble the infinitive for singular subjects and add -mos/-em for plural subjects.
Common irregulars include for, tiver, fizer, puder, quiser, vier, disser.
Do not use the future indicative after se in conditional clauses.

commonMistakes.note: Future event after quando needs future subjunctive.
